import mujoco, numpy as np

def simulate(xml_str, seed, ts):
    model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_string(xml_str)
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    nstep = int(2.0 / model.opt.timestep)
    
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    data.qpos += rng.normal(0, 0.01, size=data.qpos.shape)
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    
    for _ in range(nstep):
        mujoco.mj_step(model, data)
    
    full_physics = mujoco.mjtState.mjSTATE_FULLPHYSICS
    state = np.zeros(mujoco.mj_stateSize(model, full_physics))
    mujoco.mj_getState(model, data, state, full_physics)
    return state

xml_ref = open('model_ref.xml').read()
# Add option with different timestep
for ts in [0.004, 0.008, 0.01, 0.02]:
    xml = xml_ref.replace('<compiler autolimits=\"true\"/>', 
                          f'<compiler autolimits=\"true\"/><option timestep=\"{ts}\"/>')
    
    state_ref = simulate(xml_ref, 42, 0.002)
    state_test = simulate(xml, 42, ts)
    
    diff = np.linalg.norm(state_test - state_ref)
    maxdiff = np.max(np.abs(state_test - state_ref))
    print(f'ts={ts}: diff={diff:.6f}, maxdiff={maxdiff:.6f}, within 1e-5: {np.allclose(state_test, state_ref, atol=1e-5)}')
